Product Manager, Compliance Workflows

Fabrikam Civic is a fictional records company. This role owns compliance workflow product work on a shipped platform.

Requirements:
- Experience with privacy or compliance workflow product work
- Cross-functional alignment with legal, CX, and engineering
- Ability to sequence constrained work without people-management authority

Preferred:
- GDPR or CCPA program experience
- Background in government software

Responsibilities:
- Turn audit findings into a sequenced backlog
- Keep the platform honest about what is owned versus transferable
